name: Product Catalog, Brand Origin & Payment Channel Dashboard
description: Category performance, top SKU ranking, cross-engine brand origin federation, and digital payment market share analytics on Trino MPP.

cards.name: Top 10 Best-Selling Products by Revenue
cards.description: Top product SKUs ranked by net revenue from fact_order_items and dim_product

native.query: SELECT p.product_name, CAST(SUM(foi.sub_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_net_revenue, SUM(foi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order_items foi INNER JOIN lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.dim_product p ON foi.product_key = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_net_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

cards.name: Category Revenue Distribution
cards.description: Share of net revenue by product merchandise category

native.query: SELECT p.category, CAST(SUM(foi.sub_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS category_net_revenue FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order_items foi INNER JOIN lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.dim_product p ON foi.product_key = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY category_net_revenue DESC;

cards.name: Brand Origin Geographic Contribution (Federated)
cards.description: Federated cross-engine join between Delta Lake fact_order_items and MySQL brands

native.query: SELECT COALESCE(b.brand_origin, p.brand_origin, 'Unknown') AS country_of_origin, CAST(SUM(foi.sub_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS origin_net_revenue FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order_items foi INNER JOIN lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.dim_product p ON foi.product_key = p.product_id LEFT JOIN mysql.ecommerce_oltp.brands b ON p.brand_name = b.brand_name GROUP BY COALESCE(b.brand_origin, p.brand_origin, 'Unknown') ORDER BY origin_net_revenue DESC;

cards.name: Payment Method Revenue Market Share
cards.description: Processed order revenue split across payment methods (Momo, ZaloPay, ShopeePay, VNPay, COD, Visa)

native.query: SELECT pm.display_name, CAST(SUM(f.sub_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_net_revenue FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order f INNER JOIN lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.dim_payment_method pm ON f.payment_method_key = pm.payment_method_id GROUP BY pm.display_name ORDER BY total_net_revenue DESC;

cards.name: Payment Channel Type Share (E-Wallet vs COD)
cards.description: Adoption of cashless payment types versus Cash On Delivery

native.query: SELECT pm.type AS payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS total_orders, CAST(SUM(f.sub_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_net_revenue FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order f INNER JOIN lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.dim_payment_method pm ON f.payment_method_key = pm.payment_method_id GROUP BY pm.type ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

cards.name: Average Order Value by Payment Method
cards.description: Comparison of shopping cart basket value across payment providers

native.query: SELECT pm.display_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(f.sub_total) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id), 0), 2) AS aov FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order f INNER JOIN lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.dim_payment_method pm ON f.payment_method_key = pm.payment_method_id GROUP BY pm.display_name ORDER BY aov DESC;
